topic.para: Python 2.7 was deprecated in &suselinux; 15 SP0 and removed in SP4. Its general support ended on December 31, 2023.
Python 3.6 is the default system interpreter. It remains fully supported across all Service Packs for the entire lifetime of the &suselinux; 15 family (ending in July 2034).

Recent Python versions (Python 3.9 in SP3, 3.10 in SP4, 3.11 in SP5, 3.12 in SP6, and 3.13 in SP7) are provided via the Python 3 Module. Only the default system interpreter and the latest shipped interpreter are supported simultaneously per Service Pack. These recent interpreters are exempt from Reactive LTSS and XLSS.
